text: Twelve, twelve. The twelfth day of the twelfth month.
A full cycle closing, before a new one begins.
And that same week, the sky answers.
The Geminid meteor shower reaches its peak.
Dust from an old rock called Phaethon,
Something old, letting go. Becoming light.
This year asked a lot from you.
So before twelve twelve, ask what this cycle was trying to teach you.
Where you are. What has to break. What comes next.
Comment 222, and I'll send you the link to choose your three cards.
